title: DIY Wood Pine Garden Fence (Full Build Series)
excerpt: A full DIY guide showing how I built a wood pine garden fence using treated timber, metal anchors and a complete finishing process.
body:
## Overview This project documents the full process of building my wood pine garden fence, from structure to finishing. Although not every single step was captured on video, all the essential stages and techniques are included so you can replicate the project. The goal was to create a strong, durable and visually clean fence suitable for outdoor conditions. ## Materials Used - Treated pine wood - Zinc steel anchors - Stainless steel screws - Exterior paint - Protective varnish These materials ensure resistance to weather, moisture and long-term wear. ## Build Process The fence was built step by step, starting with the installation of the anchors and structural posts. After securing the base, the horizontal and vertical elements were assembled to form a rigid and aligned structure. Finally, everything was sanded, painted and sealed to improve both durability and appearance. ## Image Gallery
